# Serving dependency manifest

**Generated by `tools/build_serving_manifest.py` at `fecd62d2`.** Do not hand-edit.

This file exists because nothing recorded what the API needs to run. It embeds the
commit rather than a timestamp, so two runs on one commit are byte-identical and the
run-it-twice-and-diff check means something.

**A SHA above that is not `git rev-parse --short HEAD` means "regenerate", not
"wrong".** It is stale the moment anything else is committed, which is the price of
being diffable and is deliberate. Rerun the generator: if the body changes, the
serving dependencies changed and that is the news. If only this line changes, nothing
did, and committing it is optional.

Three environments, deliberately separate. The serving interpreter never imports from
any virtualenv; each venv is reached by subprocess. `backend/server.py:25` says "no
virtualenv anywhere in the serving path" and `api.py:73-74` documents one 48 lines
later -- the architecture is the hybrid below, and this table is the statement of it
that the docstring does not make.

### One more, invisible to the measurement above

`uvicorn` never appears in `sys.modules` after importing `api`, because `uvicorn.run`
is inside `if __name__ == "__main__":` at `api.py:4137` -- yet `ExecStart` runs the
file as a script, so it is required to serve. A check that only measured imports would
miss it entirely.

| what | path | OS package |
|---|---|---|
| the `uvicorn` module (used) | `/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/uvicorn/__init__.py` | `python3-uvicorn` 0.32.0-3 |
| the `uvicorn` CLI script (NOT used) | `/home/google/.local/share/../bin/uvicorn` | **not dpkg-owned** -- a user-local pip install |

The CLI wrapper being unpackaged is harmless *because nothing in the serving path
invokes it*: the unit runs `python3 backend/server.py`. It is recorded so that a future
reader who reaches for `uvicorn server:app` knows the wrapper is not managed by apt.

Reinstall with:

```bash
sudo apt install python3-annotated-types python3-anyio python3-attr python3-bcrypt python3-brotli python3-click python3-cryptography python3-email-validator python3-fastapi python3-httpx python3-idna python3-pydantic python3-pydantic-core python3-pygments python3-python-multipart python3-rich python3-sniffio python3-starlette python3-typing-extensions python3-websockets
```

## 2. Required to *serve*, but not to start

Imported at module scope inside a module `api.py` imports lazily. The process comes up
without these and fails at request time instead — which is worse than failing at boot,
because a green start reads as a working service. `tools/preflight.py` checks them.

| module | version | surface | why it is not a startup dependency |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sympy` | 1.13.3 | `/api/ravencalc` | `import ravencalc` sits inside a function at `api.py:1166`; `ravencalc.py:47` imports `sympy.parsing` at module scope |

## 4. The per-app virtualenvs — reached by subprocess, never imported

| venv | present | packages | invocation | documented at |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backend/apps/studio/.venv` | yes | 69 | subprocess: `.venv/bin/python -m apps.studio.mcp_server` | backend/apps/studio/__init__.py:23,67; mcp_server.py:4,6,28 |
| `backend/apps/sigils/.venv` | yes | 30 | subprocess: `.venv/bin/python cutout_worker.py <in.png> <out.png>` | backend/apps/sigils/cutout_worker.py:1,4,7; segment.py:48; docs/specs/sigils-spec.md:139 |
| `backend/apps/asicminer/.venv` | yes | 31 | subprocess: rig-protocol shim | backend/server.py:73-74 |
| `training/.venv` | yes | 79 | subprocess: `training/.venv/bin/python`, never imported | backend/apps/studio/plugins/reinforce/__init__.py:56; jobs.py:72,627 |

Each is its own environment with its own interpreter. A package in one is not
available to the others and none is available to the serving interpreter — which is
the point of the boundary, not an oversight.
